design.motif: A finely honed architectural stone sample: pale Hanbaiyu-like microcrystalline grain, shallow stepped joinery rebates and a few asymmetric roof-bracket alignment notches. Geometric construction marks belong to a crafted corner-tower model. No palace miniature, ornaments, dragons or floral motifs.

description.en: Pale Hanbaiyu-like microcrystalline grain, shallow stepped joinery rebates and a few asymmetric roof-bracket alignment notches.
description.zh: 细磨石材的微晶、阶式榫槽与少量斗拱定位刻痕，呼应角楼模型精密而耐看的构造。

design.rationale: The existing object, character or historical mark remains unchanged. Only a supporting working surface is interpreted from the product's purpose; no replacement Logo is generated.

description.en: Dense, dark, durable. A matte design system for information-rich software.
description.zh: 沉稳、紧凑的哑光设计系统，为信息密集的软件界面而做。

purpose.en: Give React applications a consistent set of controls, layered surfaces, charts, and page layouts.
purpose.zh: 为 React 应用提供统一的控件、分层表面、图表和页面布局。

rights: Owner-commissioned Azure OpenAI generated decoration under applicable provider terms. No third-party reference image or font was submitted. Existing Logo, font and product rights are unchanged. Do not describe raster output as handmade SVG or assert exclusive trademark rights.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance on every native RGBA pixel composited over actual Hexly normal/hover surfaces, before the left-edge mask. Text remains fully opaque.

publication: Export-time record. Upload receipts and the site release establish subsequent publication.
